Skip this one
Sep 2026 • Solo
I really wanted to like this place. The restaurant looks nice enough from the outside, and a proper steakhouse in Da Nang seemed like a good find. But unfortunately, FOR YOU SteakHouse was one of the most disappointing meals I've had in Vietnam, and honestly, a waste of money.

I ordered a medium steak and specifically made that clear to the server. What arrived was well done. Not slightly overdone, but fully cooked through. I sent it back, but when the replacement came out, it was basically the same thing. At that point I just gave up and tried to eat what was in front of me. The meat itself was tiny—we're talking maybe four or five small bites worth of actual steak. For what they were charging, I expected something substantial, not a piece of meat that looked like it came off a child's plate.

The quality was the real killer though. It was tough, chewy, and tasted like it had been sitting under a heat lamp. This isn't a budget pho stand where you'd accept that kind of quality. This is a restaurant charging steakhouse prices, and the steak was legitimately bad. I've had better beef at random restaurants on side streets that cost a tenth of the price.

Speaking of price, I nearly fell over when the bill came. We're talking premium North American steakhouse pricing for something that wouldn't pass muster at a mediocre place back home. You could eat at high-end steakhouses in the US or Canada for these prices and actually get a proper meal. The fact that they're charging that much for this quality in Da Nang, where you can get incredible food for a fraction of the cost, is hard to justify.

The rest of the dining experience didn't make up for it either. The service was slow, the sides were forgettable, and the overall vibe felt like they were just trying to capitalize on tourists who don't know any better. There are so many better options in Da Nang, even if you specifically want Western food. I genuinely cannot recommend this place. Save your money and eat literally anywhere else.

Simply fantastic
Jul 2025 • Family
Needing a change from Vietnamese food, we visited the For You Steakhouse as we really felt like a fine piece of meat.
The restaurant is located directly on the beach on the fourth floor and offers a beautiful view.
The selection of meat is excellent and the quality 1a.
I had a 300 gr. Rump steak that passed on the tongue, with fries and the blue cheese sauce, just a dream. My wife had prawns and the kids had the Wagyu burger and spaghetti. All also 1a quality.
If you want to eat a good piece of meat, this is the place for you.
